subject: Request: onboarding incentive exception for strategic pilot with HelioCore
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@heliocore.io>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot pricing & onboarding credits

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising. We have internal budget for a 3-month strategic pilot but the execs want a clearer incentive to prioritize integration work. Can Redwood do a one-time onboarding credit and an introductory per-token rate for the pilot?

High level from HelioCore: 3-month pilot, expected avg tokens/day ~ 25M, pilot starts mid-May. We can share a short SOW and an internal letter of intent.

Would you be able to confirm an example pricing package so I can bring this to procurement?

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of AI Platforms | HelioCore

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@heliocore.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing & onboarding credits

Hi Samir — appreciated the conversation.

Quick proposal for a 3-month strategic pilot:
- Intro per-token rate: $0.0006 (40% off list) for pilot period
- One-time onboarding credit: $25,000 applied against first invoice
- Implementation support: two onsite/in-depth support days + 8 hours of SE time included
- Usage cap: up to 2B tokens across pilot; overage at standard pilot rate

This is outside of our standard packaging (volume + term typically required for deeper discounts). I’m looping in Marissa, Jonas, and Karthik for approval of an exception memo — we’ll need VP/CFO sign-off for the credit and the effective unit economics. Attached is a base pricing sheet (helio_pilot_pricing_v1.xlsx) for modeling.

If this looks reasonable, Samir, can you confirm expected pilot start and an LOI? If Marissa/Jonas sign off, I’ll put together an exec-facing exception memo for VP/CFO approval.

Thanks,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0123

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing & onboarding credits

Chloe — thanks for the framing and the numbers. A couple of items I want captured before we escalate to VP/CFO: 

1) Economics: $25k onboarding credit + 40% off results in negative unit margin in month 1 if utilization skews high. Need ARR-equivalent estimate and expected retention probability to justify.
2) Guardrails: add a performance/kicker clause — if HelioCore converts to paid by month 4, we keep the pilot rate for the first 6 months, otherwise the credit is amortized and recouped.
3) Term sheet details: limits on data residency, security questionnaire completion timeline, and a list of deliverables tied to the onboarding credit.

Can you add those items into the memo draft and include expected token burn and retention assumptions? Also include any internal references (existing credits given to similar strategic customers) — that helps the exec decision.

If you send a one-page exception memo, I can route to Finance and product for a quick signoff run; Marissa will need final commercial signoff before exec review.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Commercial Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T14:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing & onboarding credits

Chloe — I like HelioCore as a strategic reference and understand procurement timelines. I support moving forward with an exec exception request, provided the memo includes:
- Clear ROI assumption and retention probability (Jonas’ ask)
- A recovery clause if conversion does not occur within 90 days of pilot end
- A defined list of success criteria and deliverables tied to the $25k credit

Once you have the memo updated, please mark it for VP/CFO signoff (tag: Executive Pricing Exception). I’ll endorse the request to the execs assuming Finance signs off on the amortization language.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Executive Pricing Exception: HelioCore strategic pilot (draft memo attached)

Team — attached is the one-page executive exception memo (exec-exception-memo-draft.pdf) and an updated pricing workbook. I incorporated Jonas’ guardrails and ROI assumptions from Samir’s usage estimates. Highlights:
- Pilot term: 90 days starting 2027-05-16
- Pilot rate: $0.0006 per token (40% off list) during pilot period
- Onboarding credit: $25,000 amortized over 6 months; recoup clause if no paid conversion within 90 days of pilot end
- Success criteria: integration of inference API, <150ms p50 latency at expected load, completion of security questionnaire and SOC2 evidence submission

Samir confirmed LOI yesterday (see thread below). Requesting Marissa to endorse and route to EVP/CFO for formal signoff. If approved, I will prepare the purchase order language and updated SOW.

Thanks — Chloe
